records.mathematical_context: The nine gray unit cells form a monotone width-5 height-5 staircase with perimeter 20. A 5-by-5 square has the same perimeter and area25, adding16 cells; any unit-grid region of perimeter20 has area at most25 by the bounding-row/column isoperimetric bound.
records.specific_reason: A one-sided staircase-completion correspondence could focus only the ten-cell gap, but outlining a selected blank patch would function as a prescribed fill region. No concise input-feature pairing was found that distinguishes the global maximum from an arbitrary selected completion without that ambiguity. No image or API request retained.

questions.provisional_direction_not_preset_proof_o: 从原灰区邻近白格的两条真实接触边提取局部不增周长条件，探索将其独立外推所有格子，忽略后续填格改变共享边归属。灰填充/格数不动、不实际涂出候选白格；先独立证16并检验集合，若只圈待数格或固定新分区就跳过。

formal_record_at_preparation.question:

Choices:
A:$A$
B:$B$
C:$C$
D:$D$
E:Neither of the pockets

questions.provisional_direction_not_preset_proof_o: 将原45度入射方向的真边段与反弹后的不同方向/台边作局部对应，探索反射后仍用原直线或把角落端点当普通反弹。口袋A-D、台边和原45度不改，不添会成为新轨道的线/箭头/假反弹点；独立得C后确定具体错误接收口袋，无合法对应则跳过。

formal_record_at_preparation.question:
A strip of paper is folded three times as shown. Determine $\beta$ if $\alpha=70^{\circ}$.
Choices:
A:$140^{\circ}$
B:$130^{\circ}$
C:$120^{\circ}$
D:$110^{\circ}$
E:$100^{\circ}$

assessment.reason: The three-fold angle construction and alpha/beta are visible. No concise wrong visual correspondence was found that preserves all fold-edge and angle-arc meanings without simply promoting an incorrect angle formula. No marks or calls.

questions.provisional_direction_not_preset_proof_o: 选原折痕两侧定义alpha、beta的真边段作来源/接收，探索急角/补角或有向折转角色迁移，区别于整纸带涂色。70度、原角弧和层次保留，不添等角符号、不量投影作新条件；先独立推120，若角归属歧义或无具体错角则跳过。

formal_record_at_preparation.question:
A rectangular piece of paper $A B C D$ with the measurements $4 \mathrm{~cm} \times 16 \mathrm{~cm}$ is folded along the line $\mathrm{MN}$ so that point $C$ coincides with point $A$ as shown. How big is the area of the quadrilateral ANMD'?
Choices:
A:$28 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
B:$30 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
C:$32 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
D:$48 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$
E:$56 \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$

assessment.reason: The shaded ANMD-prime region and C-to-A fold remain clear. Edge emphasis would not establish a useful wrong area correspondence; changing or visually replacing the semantic gray fill would obscure the requested region. No design retained.

questions.provisional_direction_not_preset_proof_o: 将原4×16矩形真实短边/半跨度与折后ANMD'对应边配对，探索把整材料面积/原完整长边赋到可见四边形面积或高度。保留C到A、D'、MN、尺寸；独立证32并说明具体哪一跨度迁移，不增折痕/尺寸/假闭片；无清楚接收边则跳过。

formal_record_at_preparation.question:
An equilateral triangle is being rolled around a unit square as shown. How long is the path that the point shown covers, if the point and the triangle are both back at the start for the first time?
Choices:
A:$4 \pi$
B:$\frac{28}{3} \pi$
C:$8 \pi$
D:$\frac{14}{3} \pi$
E:$\frac{21}{2} \pi$

assessment.reason: The marked moving point, successive triangle positions and arrows define the rolling trajectory. Adding colored points or apparent trajectories could confuse which point/path is the target. No clean edge-only correspondence with a predeclared wrong arc length was established.

questions.provisional_direction_not_preset_proof_o: 在实际图的三角形—单位方形接触处，比较跟踪顶点与滚动支点的真边角色，探索三角足迹首次复位被当标记点也复位，或把支点静止事件当同半径弧长。点/轨迹数量不动，不凭空补画新运动图、圆心/箭头；先独立分解转角半径和两种周期，无真实对应就跳过。

formal_record_at_preparation.question: Equal regular pentagonal plates are glued together along their sides to form a complete ring, as shown. How many plates make up the ring?

questions.provisional_direction_not_preset_proof_o: 把单个真正五边形顶点外转的两边与相邻板环推进的两边作局部角度角色对应，探索把72度当环推进36度，区别于整环强调。先独立证10片，不添等角弧、假中心、粘合边或新板；若只能描整轮廓则跳过。

formal_record_at_preparation.question:
A pathway consists of 10 paving stones, each $4 \mathrm{dm}$ wide and 6 dm long. A black line connects the middle points of the paving stones as shown. What is the length of the black line?
Choices:
A:$24 \mathrm{dm}$
B:$40 \mathrm{dm}$
C:$46 \mathrm{dm}$
D:$50 \mathrm{dm}$
E:$56 \mathrm{dm}$

records.reason: Five6dm long-direction and four4dm short-direction centre-to-centre route steps give46dm (C). Recoloring path segments would disturb the explicit black-line target; merely marking ten centres or whole tiles gives no precise useful false correspondence. No clean design saved.
records.mathematical_solution: A rectilinear route has five long6 and four short4 steps:5*6+4*4=46. Endpoints are tilecentres, not all ten tileedge-lengths.

questions.provisional_direction_not_preset_proof_o: 将真实4/6铺石外边与原黑线连接中心时的半跨度/跨向段作局部对应，探索按整块长度替代中心距或端部半跨度归属两次。先逐段独立证46及明确错项，不测像素；优先保留黑目标路线原色/粗细，不让彩边变新路线，无具体真对应则跳过。
